versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Smart Web Scraper (智能网页数据采集器)
- Features intelligent structure recognition for list, table, and detail pages
- Automatically extracts key fields such as titles, prices, and authors
- Supports anti-crawling strategies: User-Agent rotation, request delay, proxy pool (optional), and auto-retry
- Exports data in JSON, CSV, Excel, and supports direct database storage (MySQL/MongoDB)
- Provides command-line and config file usage with sample scenarios
